name: patchversion
description: Fixture-based prototype of a migration-safety agent: maps affected call sites for recorded breaking changes and proves deterministic fixes red-to-green in a local process. GitHub App, live monitoring, isolated sandbox and PR delivery are planned, not built.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @patchversion/shared && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w @patchversion/shared && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @patchversion/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.lint: echo 'No linter is configured in this repository; lint ran zero checks.'
scripts.prove: npm run build -w @patchversion/shared && npm run build -w @patchversion/engine && npm run prove -w @patchversion/engine
scripts.prove:real: npm run build -w @patchversion/shared && npm run build -w @patchversion/engine && npm run prove:real -w @patchversion/engine
